snapshot.title: Final Isolation Request for MCHD-INT01 and IIS Export

fields.subject: Final Isolation Request for MCHD-INT01 and IIS Export
fields.body:
Per CISA and MC-CIRP-2025, we must isolate MCHD-INT01 and the IIS export interface (MCHD-INT01: 10.72.14.22) from the county network to prevent lateral movement and data exfiltration. We have confirmed the attacker has not accessed the ClinicTrack database, but the IIS export file has been altered and is no longer trusted. We cannot proceed without a formal Cyber 1 declaration from the Incident Commander. This is a critical path for recovery.

The forensic team has preserved the full artifact of auto_cleaner.py (SHA256: a1b2c3d4e5f67890ab123456cd7890ef1234567890abc1234567890def123456) and the modified IIS export file (IIS-EXPORT-NIGHTLY-20261024-0130). The attacker used a phishing compromise of Jenna Fowler’s account (MCHD-SLOT-042) to execute the script and alter 412 records with invalid lot numbers (MMR-2026-0044 to MMR-2026-0045).

We recommend immediate Cyber 1 declaration and network isolation. Failure to act will prevent recovery and increase risk of data exfiltration and system-wide compromise.
